name: White-Label SaaS Reselling

yield.notes: Resell existing SaaS tools (HighLevel, etc.) under your brand. Margin is the spread between your cost and client price.

flags: Dependent on underlying SaaS vendor terms
Client acquisition cost can be high
Requires sales effort — not passive without clients

startup_checklist: Choose white-label platform: HighLevel ($497/mo with unlimited sub-accounts), Vendasta
Define target niche: local businesses, agencies, specific industry
Configure and brand the platform with your agency name and domain
Set pricing: typically $97-297/mo per client for $297-500/mo platform cost
Acquire first 3 clients through direct outreach, ads, or referrals
failure_modes: Can't acquire clients to cover platform subscription cost
Client churn exceeds new client acquisition
Underlying platform raises prices or changes terms
kill_criteria: Less than 3 paying clients after 6 months of active sales effort
Net margin below 30% after platform costs
sources_note: Platform pricing from HighLevel official pricing page.
